newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 24.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Agriculture and water minister signs a 441 million riyal contract to establish a pumping station and pipelines in the Eastern Province.
- Police arrests a 14-year-old boy for murdering a woman and her son.
- Saudi Arabia to set up a $10 million pharmaceutical plant in Riyadh.
- Saudi Arabia is carrying out water projects in Qassim at a cost of 362 million riyals.
- National Commercial Bank makes 915 million riyals net profit in 1996.
- A British delegation signs contracts worth 10 million riyals with Saudi businessmen.
